enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow under head. Remain still. Turn onto right side. Move arm under pillow. Pull blanket up to chin. Remain still. Turn onto back. Stretch legs. Sigh. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet: lift lid, pull down pants, sit, urinate, stand, pull up pants, flush. Turn on tap. Wash face: wet face, apply cleanser, rinse, dry. Pick up toothbrush. Brush teeth: apply toothpaste, brush, rinse mouth, spit. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling water with the kettle, toasting bread and eating a relaxed breakfast on a public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch to boil. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, and tea bag. Take out two slices of bread. Place slices in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take out plate, knife, and cup. Wait for toast. Take out toast. Spread butter on toast. Pour boiled water into cup. Add tea bag to cup. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the sofa reading news on the phone and watching morning TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through news. Look up at TV. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Continue reading phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel again. Put down remote. Pick up phone again. Scroll. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing ingredients and cooking a batch of meals, then wiping down the counters and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Place on cutting board. Wash vegetables. Peel vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Transfer food to containers. Wipe counters with cloth. Open dishwasher. Load dishes. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room floor and tidying up clutter
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put away vacuum. Pick up items on floor. Place items on shelves. Arrange cushions. Fold blankets. Pick up trash. Throw trash in bin. Wipe table. Adjust TV remote. Sit on sofa. Look around.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping for the week and stopping for a coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Take cart. Pick up items. Place items in cart. Go to checkout. Pay. Bag items. Walk to café. Order coffee. Pay. Receive coffee. Sit at table. Drink coffee. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Put away groceries.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating lunch, then rinsing the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Prepare ingredients. Cook lunch. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Stand up. Collect dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Wipe counters. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the bed with the fan on, reading a book and scrolling on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a leisurely walk in the neighbourhood park
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to park. Enter park. Walk along path. Look around. Sit on bench. Stand up. Continue walking. Stop to watch birds. Walk further. Turn around. Walk back. Exit park. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Take off shoes. Sit on sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Pick up AC remote. Turn on air conditioner. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Adjust AC temperature. Continue watching. Pick up remote to turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Prepare ingredients. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Preheat oven. Place tray in oven. Set timer. Check food. Turn off induction cooker. Take out tray from oven. Turn off oven. Plate food. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Collect plates. Scrape food into trash. Load dishwasher. Wash pots. Dry pots. Wipe counters. Wipe table. Turn off light. Walk out. Put away leftovers. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Wash hands. Dry hands. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing a game on the console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up controller. Turn on console. Start game. Play game. Pause game. Pick up remote. Change TV channel. Watch TV. Put down remote. Resume game. Play game. Save game. Turn off console. Put down controller. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on water and adjust temperature. Wet body and apply soap. Scrub and rinse body. Turn off water. Dry body with towel. Put on pajamas. Turn off light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer with the desk lamp on to plan personal errands for the coming week
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Turn on computer. Open calendar app. Type notes. Click on dates. Write list. Check email. Close email. Open browser. Search for errands. Close browser. Save document. Turn off computer. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Lie down.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn onto back. Move legs. Pull blanket up. Turn onto other side. Adjust blanket. Remain still. Turn head. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Sigh. Turn onto stomach. Remain still. Continue sleeping.
